top_categories.workout_context: 67 miles on fast tropical plains with a decisive mountain burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
Race-pace efforts that mimic GFNY Villavicencio's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before April.
When someone attacks on fast tropical plains with a decisive mountain, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.

Road-specific control matters at GFNY Villavicencio. Practice on fast tropical plains with a decisive mountain: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 67 miles.
63ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
At GFNY Villavicencio, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
Base fitness for GFNY Villavicencio. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of GFNY Villavicencio. Train it until it feels boring.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at GFNY Villavicencio. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.

Steeper ramps, positioning, or pace changes on fast tropical plains with a decisive mountain can demand short hard efforts. Practice them without compromising the sustained work that defines the course.
Varied gradients on fast tropical plains with a decisive mountain demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
The aerobic base that lets you ride fast tropical plains with a decisive mountain at tempo for 67 miles without cracking. No shortcuts.

race_overlay.heat: April in Villavicencio, Meta, Colombia can bring heat. Complete 3–4 heat exposure sessions in the final 2 weeks before GFNY Villavicencio. Increase sodium intake 48 hours before race day.
race_overlay.nutrition: Use training to rehearse an eating and drinking plan for GFNY Villavicencio's 67 miles. Start early and use products you tolerate. Use the organizer's current resupply plan for final carry decisions.
race_overlay.altitude: Altitude may change sustainable power and recovery at GFNY Villavicencio. Use conservative pacing and test any travel strategy before the event.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at GFNY Villavicencio rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on fast tropical plains with a decisive mountain climb to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, Race Simulation, and VO2max to prepare you for 67 miles of fast tropical plains with a decisive mountain climb in Villavicencio, Meta, Colombia.
